summary: Implemented src/goal/lessons.ts with persistent lesson storage at resolveStateDir()/goal-lessons.json, atomic save (temp+rename+chmod), and exported loadLessons/saveLessons/addLesson/getLessonsForContext (exact workingDir match only)/clearLessons/removeLessons. Added src/goal/lessons.test.ts covering add/load round-trip, exact-match-only filtering (excluding ancestor and '*' entries), clear by workingDir and global, removeLessons behavior, and source field preservation. Verified with pnpm vitest run src/goal/lessons.test.ts and pnpm build.
